name: Dale: don't stare at them too long
notes: Played by FS47Attention (S47Attention.cpp, N1110) with the first warning ever, or on day 3 if nothing has warned by then (N1110 pace). The rule, said once, 13 s after the warning so it does not collide with the warning's own beat; 15 s later the second line of the lesson: lamp off, hold still, the small ones look past.

beats.text: Those lights you keep looking at. I would not stare at them too long. Out here they notice. Over.
Dale, on the walkie: don't stare at the lights too long. Out here they notice.
If one comes close, kill the lamp and hold still. The small ones look right past you. Over.
